name: model-selection
description: Empirical substrate/model selection service (W042): given a typed SelectionDemand (the W039 position vocabulary — body/substrate requirements + capability demands — plus the scope, the benchmark policy, and the registered candidate substrates), the W040 capability registry, the W041 skill records, and the benchmark surface (the benchmarks/model-capability catalogue + the W038 experiment evaluations the cited evidence was measured through), `selectSubstrate(demand, registry, skills, benchmarks)` performs the PURE selection walk: for each registered+measured candidate it proves eligibility (the W039 requirement vocabulary, compared as data), proves capability coverage through W040's own `matchCapabilityDemand` seam (reasons carried verbatim), and proves benchmark coverage (the candidate's evidence citations cover the demanded benchmark's declared W037 holdout atoms — compared AS DATA, never re-scored), then ranks deterministically (carried evidence counts, canonical-id order tiebreaks — A9) and produces the SelectionPlan: the selected candidate, the full evidence chain (which capabilities, which skills, which experiments/evaluations, which benchmark coverage), the deterministic content-addressed selection id (selection-<digest>), the ablation/model-substitution variants (W039's substitution axis as data), and every rejected candidate's typed reasons (never a silent drop). Fail-closed at every seam: a selection citing no measured evidence is REJECTED with a loud typed error naming R052; a deprecated/revoked capability in the chain is refused with the W040 lifecycle carried verbatim; scope mismatch, an unknown benchmark in the policy, an invalid catalogue/registry/skill set, or a cited evaluation missing from the surface is a loud typed error. The selector COMPOSES typed plans — it never executes, never trains, never runs benchmarks.
